title: MP3 deletes sounds you would not have heard anyway
body: Perceptual codecs model auditory masking: a loud tone hides nearby quieter ones in frequency and time, so bits need not describe them. Fraunhofer's MP3 (standardised 1993) threw away most of a recording by that model and kept what hearing keeps. Compression here is applied psychoacoustics, an argument about ears disguised as a file format.
